name: Red Cross Web QA Agent
description: 24/7 QA copilot for the rodekors.no website rebuild on Enonic XP CMS + Next.js + Digdir Designsystemet. Built to Trine Bruu's Teststrategi 30.3: Azure DevOps as official test tool, Sev1-4 + KatA-C dual severity, V-model test levels, full Fundy donation-flow + Vipps handoff coverage. 41 REST routes across 23 audit suites. Includes a Phase H+ Security & Privacy workbench with persisted baselines, ADO REST dispatch (real with PAT, mock otherwise), and ADO Sprint paste-and-generate / live-fetch integrations.

tools.name: generate_test_plan
tools.description: Generate a sprint test plan from an Azure DevOps work item / user story. Emits ado_work_items with work_item_type, priority 1-4, test_level (unit/sit/system/uat/performance/static-review).

tools.name: paste_to_plan
tools.description: Paste a real ADO Sprint item (User Story / Task / Bug) and get a Røde Kors-aware test plan. Heuristic parser; bilingual NO + EN; auto-detects Røde Kors content type (Distrikt / Forening / Aktivitet / Kampanje / ...).

tools.name: fetch_sprint_items
tools.description: Pull live Sprint backlog items from Azure DevOps via WIQL when ADO_PAT is in server env. Mock-first fallback when PAT absent. Returns id/title/type/state/area/iteration/description/AC/tags/url.

tools.name: run_security_scan
tools.description: OWASP Top 10 + GDPR + secrets + headers (13 checks). Phase H+ adds the qa_security workbench with persisted baselines.

tools.name: run_accessibility_check
tools.description: axe-core + Lighthouse + manual checklist (WCAG 2.2 AA, 12 checks). Phase G adds NVDA screen-reader script generator + WAVE WebAIM audit.

tools.name: run_enonic_performance
tools.description: Enonic XP-specific perf: Guillotine GraphQL waterfall + N+1, ISR latency, image service, publish ack (10 checks + hot queries with p95 baselines).

tools.name: dispatch_to_ado
tools.description: Push a finding to Azure DevOps as a work item. Real REST when ADO_PAT is set; mock-first otherwise. Idempotent: same finding → same work item.

tools.name: generate_sprint_report
tools.description: Auto-generated end-of-sprint report (status, findings, recommendations) for Trine Bruu per Teststrategi 30.3 §8.
